runtimes.value: mlx-audio (mlx-community 4-bit and fp16); voxtral.c (pure C, 'make mps' for Apple Silicon Metal); voxmlx (MLX port listed on the model card); transformers >= 5.2.0 native. vLLM nightly is the officially recommended runtime (CUDA). llama.cpp: streaming audio infrastructure for voxtral-realtime merged 15.10.2026 (PR #30629), CLI/server follow-ups in progress, not yet in the multimodal docs
runtimes.note: The model card marks community ports as untested by Mistral. transformers on MPS unverified. Some community ports reported slow on Mac (HN, Feb 2026).

Sources: Hacker News comments, Hugging Face discussions, issues of Ollama, QwenLM, resemble-ai/chatterbox and mlx-audio (now `Neywa-Labs/mlx-audio`). **Reddit could not be read.** Items from before 13.05.2026 that are not launch discussions are marked "older". web.summary: Good French and English streaming; language detection fragile, a risk for German; use an MLX runtime.
web.verdict: Good FR/EN streaming; fragile language detection (German); last open Voxtral

comments.text: No language hint: **German** first transcribed as Portuguese; Italian mistaken for other languages ([HF #19, 12–16.02.2026](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime-2602/discussions/19)).
When the speaker switches language, it may translate instead of transcribing (French ↔ Spanish) ([HF #21, 13.02.2026](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime-2602/discussions/21)).
Some community ports are slow on Mac ([refulgentis, 10.02.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46955514)).
Voxtral 3 is API-only: this is the last open version ([T0mSIlver, 21.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50178093)).

Over 95 % success in English, **French** and Spanish ([HF #21, 14.02.2026](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime-2602/discussions/21)); impressive results on poor-quality audio in French and English ([blobinabottle, 04.02.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46890192)).
macOS dictation app via MLX: a dramatic improvement over Whisper ([T0mSIlver, 25.02.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47149479)).
